title: Sunset with Bare Necessities
hosts: Gabe Clouston, Vinny Lunar, Sam Z

rows.title: Veranito de San Juan
notes: “we're gonna move over to Chile actually with Nuan Afrobeat collaborating with Juanito Alaja this is Veranito de San Juan”
Title track of Chilean cumbia artist Juanito Ayala's 2026 solo album, featuring Chilean Afrobeat band Newen Afrobeat as a guest collaborator.

rows.title: Descarga China
notes: “before that we had uh manteca with descarga china that one was from uh 2023 ... these guys are based in london”
Track from 'Oye' (2023) by Manteca, a London-based Latin jazz/salsa combo led by Martha Acosta and Javier Fioramonti.
